solution: I cannot determine the exact count. There are 118124 permutations of 1 through 9 with exactly three left-to-right maxima before excluding fixed points. Of these, 13068 start with 1 and 13068 end with 9; their overlap has 720 permutations. Thus the requested count is at most 118124 − 13068 − 13068 + 720 = 92708, but fixed points in the other positions still need to be excluded.
insight: The number c(n,k) of permutations of n elements with k left-to-right maxima satisfies c(n,k) = (n−1)c(n−1,k) + c(n−1,k−1).
insight_justification: Insert the smallest element into a permutation of the other n−1 elements. In the first position it creates one new maximum; in any of the other n−1 positions it creates none and leaves the existing maxima unchanged.
